div.head: Quadr II Praef 12
div.ab: Hoc enim est emendatio Willelmi regis in legibus Anglicis, quicquid honestum et utile circumquaque probaueris, quod beatissimus rex et dominus noster cotidianis laudibus illustrare non desinit.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 543 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)
div.ab: For this is the amendment of King William in the English laws: whatever you have found honourable and useful on every side; which our most blessed king and lord does not cease to make illustrious with daily praises.
